title: Discover hosts doing possible network scans
description:
Looking for high volume queries against a given RemoteIP, per DeviceName, RemotePort and Process.
Please change the Timestamp window according your preference/objective, as also the subnet ranges that you want to analyze against.
query: ('Log Source' = 'Microsoft Defender Endpoint Network Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Sysmon Network Logs') and ('Destination IP' like '172.16*' or 'Destination IP' like '192.168*') | stats count as Count by 'Host Name (Server)', 'Destination IP', 'Destination Port', 'Parent Process Name' | stats distinctcount('Destination Port') as RemotePortCount by 'Host Name (Server)', 'Destination IP', 'Parent Process Name' | where RemotePortCount > 10
